main_text.p: ܣܝܪ Syr. Coena: Lucę 14. 16. Plur. ܣܝܪ In coenis, Matth. 23. 6.
חשן חושנא Ch. Pectorale, Hebr. חשן.
חשק Ch. Ligare, alligare: Sternere, insternere equum vel asinum. Part. Pehil חשיק Stratus. Plur. חשיקין.

חששׁ Ch. & Syr. Dolere, Anxium, curiosum, sollicitum esse, curare, curam habere. Item Syr. Pati, perpeti, compati, condolere, experiri dolorem. Ex Pahel וחשחשית Aut fovi cum dolore, Numer. 11. 12. in Jon.
Syr. Passionibus obnoxius, passibilis, Jac. 5. 17. Plural. Syr. ὁμοιοπαθὴς, Passionibus obnoxii, Act. 14. 14.
Syr. Passio, ad Hebr. 2. 9. Plur. Syr. Passiones, perpesiones, affectus, 2. ad Cor. 1. 6. ad Colos. 1. 24. 1. ad Thess. 4. 5.
מחתיתא Ch. Thuribulum, Acerra, quasi Receptaculum ignis vel carbonum, ad suffitum faciendum, Levit. 16. 12. Plural. מחתיתא: מחתין.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek forms are approximated; several Syriac words are only partly legible in the scan. The Hebrew mark at the foot right is a catchword-like signature and is noted here only.
